question:
The line chart below shows the number of male teachers and female teachers in 5 schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e43a61dab781d79284a2fc6d989fc3667d10622f336d5064582e9dc3f7ab1193.png] 

Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. The total number of male teachers in all the 5 schools is 106.61 percent of the total number of females teachers in the 5 schools.

II. The number of female teachers in school E is 11.73 percent more the number of male teachers in school I.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of male teachers in all 5 schools = 260 + 280 + 270 + 250 + 230 = 1290

Total number of female teachers in all 5 schools = 280 + 270 + 220 + 210 + 230 = 1210

Percentage = 1290/1210 × 100 = 106.61

Statement I is correct
